settings.heading: Choose around your day.
settings.intro: A short guide to finding the right object for the job.

settings.heading: A few useful answers.
settings.subheading: Start here, then talk to us if you need a hand.

settings.label: Eyewear: start with fit.
settings.content: Compare the frame dimensions with a pair you already wear. Review the lens and audio information on the product page before choosing a finish.

settings.label: Carry: start with what you bring.
settings.content: Measure your laptop and consider the items that travel with it. Check the bag dimensions and compartment details instead of relying on capacity alone.

settings.label: Power: start with your devices.
settings.content: Compare the stated input and output specifications with your devices and cables. Available power depends on the connections in use.

settings.label: Desk: start with connections.
settings.content: List your display, network and peripheral requirements. Check host-device compatibility before selecting a dock or hub.

settings.title: Still deciding?
settings.body: Ask a product question or browse every object.
